scientific-figure-v1.decision: All required dimensions need independent human acceptance. No evaluated model may be its own sole judge.

dimensions.criterion: Identify time in hours and measured response; distinguish the log-scale second panel.
Panel 1 treatment values are 2,4,6,8 at 0,1,2,3 hours; control is 2,2,3,3. Read approximate values within 0.25.
Error bars represent SD of three independent fictional replicates. Do not infer p-values or significance.
A plotted trend alone does not establish causal mechanism or population generalization.
Cite the actual PDF page or PPTX slide and the exact asset hash; inspect pixels, not just extracted titles.

scientific-figure-v1.required_expertise: Scientific graph interpretation and experimental design
